report_reconstruction.acceptance: For each direct arm reconstruct all 24,342 expected cells from frozen source and typed physical event/stock/mission/system ledgers, then compare every native cell, table/column metadata, instance name, row order, interval endpoints, null and ID. Station-selected outputs share the same SXO and differ by selector only. Compare selector-specific ItemResults and totals to item count, movement, backorder and time integrals. Require consistency of duplicate System/Stock/Summary values across default and three selected reports. The 498 observed cross-arm changed cells are only a descriptive crosscheck, never an oracle copied from the child report.
report_reconstruction.numeric_rule: Exact strings, IDs, nulls, booleans, source integers, event counts, zero and whole-bin state. For a field genuinely computed from printed noninteger event edges, derive per-edge half-last-displayed-decimal-hour uncertainty and propagate through time-average denominators (0.5h bins, 36h totals where relevant) and known event coefficients; add at most 5e-7 native decimal serialization allowance. No blanket tolerance for a count/zero or integer-looking boundary. Unknown field formula, missing edge, ambiguous matching or excessive bound is NO_GO.
